pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES: NOUNS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can you group things that cannot be counted?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify count, non- count, singular, and plural nouns from a variety of texts
2. use count, non- count, singular, and plural nouns in sentences

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify count, non- count, singular, and plural nouns from a variety of texts
   In simple words: practise until you can identify count, non- count, singular, and plural nouns from a variety of texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use count, non- count, singular, and plural nouns in sentences
   In simple words: practise until you can use count, non- count, singular, and plural nouns in sentences. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
4. Show that you can: identify count, non- count, singular, and plural nouns from a variety of texts

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Listen to an audio text on the theme of science and health education, and pick out the target nouns,
2. Construct sentences using the specified types of nouns orally and in writing,
3. Unity is enhanced as learners work together to identify the different types of nouns in the classroom.
4. Respect is achieved as learners take turns to work with peers to create posters using the learnt nouns. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs)
5. Effective communication is achieved as the learner uses nouns in varied contexts correctly.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify count, non- count, singular, and plural nouns from a variety of texts
2. use count, non- count, singular, and plural nouns in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
